install: pnpm exec paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy cookie custom-html preferredLanguage baseLocale

sudo systemctl start postgresql && timeout 60 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done' && (sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='smilecv'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE ROLE smilecv LOGIN PASSWORD 'smilecv'") && (sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='smilecv'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createdb -O smilecv smilecv)

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done' && pnpm db:migrate && exec pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort

setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
warmup: pnpm exec paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy cookie custom-html preferredLanguage baseLocale
